title: Diesel Money
pitch: Fitz borrowed from Sal to get his lorry running. It runs. He hasn't paid, and says old drivers don't owe anyone.

clue_a.label: The boxcar
lines: Four new lorry tyres, still in their wrapping, stacked in the boxcar. Not cheap. Not paid for with nothing.

clue_b.label: The van
lines: His run sheet, stuffed in the burned-out van's door. Three loads this week. Paid on delivery, every one.
